model: classical XY model H = -sum cos(theta_i - theta_j), J = 1, periodic simple cubic lattice (2D square for K3). Tc(3D) = 2.20184 (literature beta_c = 0.454165), used as the input crossing point of the quench; K2 checks it.

theory.KZ: n ~ tauQ^-alpha, alpha = (D - d) nu / (1 + z nu); D = 3, line defects d = 1.
theory.3D_XY_modelA: nu = 0.6717, z = 2: alpha = 2*0.6717/(1+1.3434) = 0.5733 (the honest target: our dynamics is model A)
theory.3D_XY_modelF_helium: z = 3/2: alpha = 0.668 (NOT what our dynamics can test)
theory.freeze_out: t_hat = tauQ^(z nu/(1+z nu)) = tauQ^0.573 (time unit 1 sweep, prefactor 1 by convention)

K1.dynamics: checkerboard Metropolis (proposal +-1 rad), linear quench T(t) = Tc (1 - t/tauQ), start at 1.2 Tc after 200 sweeps of equilibration there; t = 0 at Tc crossing.
K1.count: vortex line length per site = sum over all plaquettes of |winding| / L^3, on a COPY of the field cooled by gradient flow (T = 0) for b * t_hat; counted at t = a * t_hat after Tc.
K1.fit: least squares of ln n vs ln tauQ over all 7 tauQ (seed means); 95% CI by bootstrap over seeds (resampling the 8 seeds independently at each tauQ, 4000 resamples, percentile interval).
K1.PASS_prediction_beyond_mean_field: 95% CI of alpha (main protocol) EXCLUDES 0.5 AND INCLUDES 0.5733.
sensitivity_reported: a in {1, 2, 4} x b in {0.25, 0.5, 1}: 9 alphas (same runs)
L = 32 (8 seeds, same tauQ) and L = 64 (4 seeds, tauQ 256-4096) finite-size check
mean-field protocol: t_hat = tauQ^0.5 (a = 2, b = 0.5), L = 48, 6 seeds
K1.ROBUST_flag: in addition to PASS: all 9 (a,b) alphas within 0.05 of the main alpha, AND the L = 64 alpha within 0.05 of the L = 48 alpha on the same tauQ window, AND the mean-field-protocol alpha also excludes 0.5. If PASS but not ROBUST, the claim is downgraded to 'indicative'.

K2.method: equilibrium Swendsen-Wang (embedded Ising, Wolff reflection) + 1 over-relaxation per sweep, L = 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 at beta = 1/2.20184; 1000 thermalisation sweeps, then measurements (L=8-16: 20000, L=24: 12000, L=32: 8000).  Binder ratio U4 = <m^4>/<m^2>^2; derivatives d ln<|m|>/d beta and d ln<m^2>/d beta by fluctuation formulas ~ L^(1/nu); U4(T) by single-histogram reweighting.
K2.nu_estimate: mean of the two log-derivative power-law fits over L = 8..32; error = jackknife (20 blocks) combined with half the difference between the two estimators and between fit windows 8..32 vs 12..32.
K2.PASS: |nu - 0.6717| <= 0.05 AND the U4 crossing temperature of (16, 32) within 0.5% of 2.20184. Report also how far from mean field (0.5) and the crossing value of U4 (literature ~1.243).

K3.a_pair: 2D, L = 128, vortex at x0 - d/2, antivortex at x0 + d/2, d = 24, arctan ansatz relaxed by gradient flow for t = 3; then inertial dynamics theta'' = -gamma theta' + sum sin(theta_j - theta_i), gamma = 0, Verlet dt = 0.05. Lattice wave speed c = 1 (omega^2 = sum 2(1 - cos k)).
K3.a_PASS: (i) the pair approaches and annihilates (vortex count -> 0) before t = 300; (ii) total energy conserved to 1e-3 relative; (iii) maximum vortex speed < c = 1; (iv) after annihilation the energy (>= 90% of the initial pair energy) leaves as a wave whose front moves at 1.0 +- 0.1.
K3.b_kick: same pair given a Lorentz-boosted initial velocity v = 0.5 perpendicular to the separation (theta(x, y - v t) with gamma factor, theta' = -v gamma d_y theta): report the measured initial centroid speed (expected ~0.5) and whether it stays < 1. Report only (no pass/fail).
K3.c_KZ_2D: 2D quench L = 128, tauQ = 256, stop at T = 0.2 (t = 0.909 tauQ), then inertial dynamics gamma = 0.02 from the frozen configuration (momenta 0): vortex number vs time. PASS: vortex number drops by >= 50% in t = 200 (defects move and annihilate) while kinetic energy (waves) appears.
K3.d_KZ_3D: a K1 final 3D configuration (L = 48, tauQ = 1024, cooled) under inertial dynamics gamma = 0.02: line length vs time (report only).
